text:
This tool turns Markdown into PDFs quickly. It's written in Go and ships as a single 8 MB binary, so there's no runtime to install and no dependencies. You don't need Python, Node, or LaTeX. Download it, put it in your PATH, and run it.

It renders 100 pages in 1.2 seconds. Headings, code blocks, and tables come out clean, whether the input is a short note or a full book.

It's free and open source under the MIT license, so you can use, modify, and share it however you like.
